evidence.note: Active 'Title' nav item is in a saturated blue on a pale pill, marking the current section (a focus role); other nav items are neutral grey.
Title is near-black serif, subtitle mid-grey sans, byline grey italic; no role colour is used on text for emphasis.
Many blurred blobs in the same blue hue (top centre, right edge, bottom centre, small dots near the right) are scattered over the background as atmosphere, encoding nothing.

rationale: The blue that marks focus in the nav is also spread across the background as decorative blurred blobs that carry no meaning. That is a role colour used decoratively, which matches the fail descriptor, even though the text colours themselves are role-clean.
